{{Quote|This is my Padawan Learner, Anakin Skywalker. Some juma juice for the two of us. And some information.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi orders juma juice at Dex's Diner while soliciting information on Granta Omega from Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Juma Juice''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that could have a variety of harmful effects on the drinker if too much was consumed. The consumer would become drowsy, and unable to balance himself would drop down and remain unconscious for a matter of hours. While on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] purchased Juma Juice to put [[Vogga]] the Hutt's [[Kath hound/Legends|kath hounds]] to sleep, allowing Vogga's secret stash to be looted. Juma Juice was also the favorite drink of the Exile's student, [[Atton Rand]].

While accompanying the Jedi Exile on Nar Shaddaa, Atton Rand visited a local cantina to enjoy some Juma, but before he could be finish his drink, he was attacked by the [[Twin Suns (assassins)|Twin Suns]]. After defeating them, Atton returned to the ''Ebon Hawk'' to warn his companions.

Juma Juice was still a popular drink millennia later, during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], though by this time, it had become a non-alcoholic beverage. It was favored by many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of that era, and was bright yellow in color. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], for example, both enjoyed the drink. It was memorably served to them by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] duo first embarked on their search for [[Force void/Legends|Force Blank]] [[Granta Omega]], the son of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]]; unbeknownst to them, a disguised Omega had, in that very moment, been watching them from the shadows across Dexter's café.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi" />

Juma Juice could be found at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] and in the [[Entertainment Promenade]], to the right of the [[Pazaak Den]].
